title: I've found my people
content: For many years now, the vast majority of my dreams take place in one location that I often refer to as the megaplex. It's a vast complex that includes a mall, an amusementpatk, large public parks and towering hotels. The architecture ranges from mundane, to fantastical to brutalist. There is a rarely seen Security force there that is made up of heavily armed sentient warthogs 7-8 feet tall in police uniforms and driving large brown vans that resemble UPS vans.
